robot_trajectories 0.1: every kind opens in 3D, with its joint and Cartesian views and a 1D–6D switch

Zach's catalog feedback (Daily Note 2026-11-18): “for each trajectory 1. Show a 3D view (even for a 1D thing thats a single joint) 2. Show the joint space view and the cartesian space view 3. Have the option to swith between 1D, 2D, 3D, 6D (as applicable) and mamke sure that you have this for all of them.” Package at 3651293 (v0.1.0); report built 2026-11-18 15:20 MST.

All 75 registered kinds play in 3D on the real meshes, each with its joint-space and Cartesian views and a dimension switch: 162 of the 182 dimensions they apply to play; the other 20 are disabled with the library's own refusal on the switch. The 68 catalog rows are all implemented (68), plus 7 plans and higher-order kinds. The package itself is unchanged; the page and its previews live in bam_ws reports/media/trajectory-generator-2026-11-18/, built by the lane's build_kind_previews.py (not committed yet).

Quick start (the V1 API), run while building this report

Every kind is a plain function f(space, ..., start=None) -> robot_msgs JointTrajectory. The robot is injected into a JointSpace; the task arrives as points and numbers. Run in the package's venv against 3651293:

import numpy as np
from fixtures import robots  # the package's test fixtures: CAN 11's limits, the UR5e's description and DH kinematics
from robot_trajectories import JointSpace, catalog, chain, kinds, pick_and_place, pid_tuning, split, step_train, summary

space = JointSpace.from_limits(robots.PENDULUM_LIMITS)  # the robot, injected: bare joint limits
session = chain(pid_tuning(space, joint="can11"), step_train(space, joint="can11", steps_fraction=(0.3, -0.3)))
print(summary(session))
print(len(split(session)), "rest-to-rest pieces")

arm = JointSpace.from_description(robots.UR5E_DESCRIPTION, max_acceleration=6.0).within(robots.UR5E_DEMO_BOX)
arm = arm.with_kinematics(robots.UR5eKinematics())  # FK/IK passed in: the Cartesian kinds unlock
tool = arm.forward(arm.home)[:3, 3]
cycle = pick_and_place(arm, tool + (0.08, -0.08, -0.12), tool + (-0.08, 0.10, -0.12), lift_m=0.08)
print(summary(cycle))

found = catalog(use_case="conveyor_pick_and_place", space=arm)
print(len(kinds()), "kinds registered; conveyor_pick_and_place:", ", ".join(entry.name for entry in found.implemented))

Kinds by family

Catalog rows ↔ kinds by catalog_id (one kind per row); plans are registry kinds no row names. A dimension is “applicable” when the kind declares it (joint and torque kinds: joints moving at once) or, for a Cartesian kind, on every robot — its dimension is the geometry's, so every robot is tried and the ones that cannot trace it refuse.

Plugins: kinds and time laws from other packages

Simple kinds live in the package (numpy + robot_msgs). A time law that needs another library is a plugin, found by entry point (robot_trajectories.time_laws). Two providers of one name are refused, never ranked. The catalog's two plugin-served kinds are filtered by Built → Needs a plugin on the page; their previews were generated in the plugin's own venv.

How the previews are made

  • The motion is the package's own: each kind's default call on one robot per dimension, the richest space the test fixtures offer (every model a labelled stand-in):
    • 1D 1-DOF pendulum (CAN 11): CAN 11 limits, drive limit 5 N·m (stand-in), jerk 200 rad/s³ (stand-in), home at the gravity bottom, lane B's CAN 11 dynamics stand-in (card values)
    • 2D 2-DOF five-bar: drive limits, reach map (closed form), closed-form tool point, lane B's gravity stand-in, drive limit 20 N·m (stand-in), jerk 100 rad/s³ (stand-in), home at the bench READY
    • 3D UR5e, three joints (pan, lift, elbow): demo box, DH kinematics restricted to three joints, position only (built here), lane B's gravity stand-in, three joints, drive limit 150 N·m (stand-in), jerk 40 rad/s³ (stand-in), the test scene, wrist held at READY
    • 6D 6-DOF UR5e: demo box, DH kinematics + damped least squares IK, lane B's gravity stand-in, drive limit 150 N·m (stand-in), jerk 40 rad/s³ (stand-in), the test scene (floor + one box), home at READY
  • Exceptions to the default call, each in kind_generate.call_plan: the four kinds with required arguments get a few-cm example from the start's tool point (the tests' own values); on the planar five-bar a Cartesian kind starts at the tests' Cartesian start with the plane's up / across; home and return_to_ready start halfway to the room's corner (from home they are empty).
  • Rendering is bam_ws's shared kit (build_previews.py's robots: pinocchio FK for the UR5e, the closed-form linkage for the five-bar, the rig for the pendulum), one lazy file per (kind, dimension). Long kinds are cut at 60 s, and say so in their title. Torque-commanded kinds play the dynamics stand-in's predicted motion, and say so.
  • The drawn path is the path the kind computed: pairwise tool distances, display FK vs the package's kinematics, agree to {"2D": 0.0001, "3D": 0.0, "6D": 0.0} mm (the frames differ by a rigid motion).

Decided for you (each undoable)

  • 3D is the UR5e on pan, lift and elbow with the wrist held at READY (position-only kinematics, built in the lane's kind_generate.py). Undo: drop the 3D slot there.
  • Cartesian kinds are tried on every robot, so a straight line shows on the five-bar, the 3-joint and the 6-joint UR5e; their 1D slot shows the pendulum's refusal. Undo: applicable() in kind_generate.py.
  • Stand-in jerk limits (the tests' values: pendulum 200, UR5e 40 rad/s³; five-bar 100, no test states one) so the two jerk-limited kinds generate. Undo: the constants at the top of kind_generate.py.
  • The card opens in a drawer 58 % of the window wide (640-1100 px), so the 3D view sits beside the plots at 1440 px. Undo: DRAWER_DEFAULT in page.js.

Left

  • A pendulum kinematics (its payload on an arc) would turn the 17 Cartesian 1D refusals into honest “unreachable” ones or short arcs: not in the fixtures, so not invented here.
  • The torque command itself is not plotted (the card shows the predicted motion); a torque panel is a kit change.
